blocks.text: 2 Chronicles 5 contains 14 verses. It opens with: Thus all the work that Solomon wrought for the house of Jehovah was finished. And Solomon brought in the things that David his father had dedicated, even the silver, and the gold, and all the vessels, and put them in the treasuries of the house of God. It concludes with: so that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud: for the glory of Jehovah filled the house of God.
